sourceText:
My Self‑Check
Read each line to Seif and let him choose the face — do not choose for him. Every "not yet" tells you exactly which activity to play again. Notice the word
yet: it teaches him that not knowing something is only temporary.
After each unit, ask: what can I do? ☺ ☻ ☹
I can nearly not yet
1 I can say what makes something a living thing.
2 I can name the parts of a plant and what each one does.
3 I can say what a plant needs to stay healthy.
4 I can name the parts of my body.
5 I can name the five senses and where each one is.
6 I can tell the difference between an object and a material.
7 I can describe what different materials are like.
8 I can say what a push is and what a pull is.
9 I can say which objects float and which sink.
10 I can name sources of sound.
11 I can explain how a sound gets fainter as it travels.
12 I can name things that need electricity to work.
13 I can say which materials a magnet attracts.
14 I can talk about oceans, lakes, rivers, streams and ponds.
15 I can say what soil is made from.
16 I can say that we live on the planet Earth.
17 I can say that the Sun is a star that gives us heat and light.
18 I can make a prediction and then test it.
19 I can read a bar chart and a pictogram.
20 I can record what I find out in a table.
I still need more help with
